# AI Travel Pro

> AI Travel Pro (aitravelpro.net) is an AI travel itinerary planner. You enter a
> destination, trip length, budget and travel style, and it generates a complete
> day-by-day itinerary in about 30 seconds — activities, restaurants, transport
> guidance, interactive maps and booking links. Pay-per-trip from $4.99, no
> subscription required. Itineraries are generated with Claude (Anthropic).

AI Travel Pro is a web application. There is nothing to install and no account
required to browse. It is a travel planning tool, not a booking agent or a travel
agency: bookings happen on partner sites, and travellers should verify opening
hours, transport schedules and availability before travelling.

## What it does

- **Day-by-day itineraries**: a structured plan for each day of the trip, paced
  to the traveller's stated style rather than a generic list of attractions.
- **Activities and attractions**: suggestions matched to interests, trip length
  and budget, with practical notes (approximate costs, best time of day, tips).
- **Restaurant recommendations**: places to eat mapped to each day and area.
- **Interactive maps**: each day plotted so the route makes geographic sense.
- **Transport guidance**: trains and rail, subways and metro, buses and coaches,
  taxis and ride-share, airport transfers, ferries and boats — chosen per city.
- **Booking links**: hotel and tour links to partner sites. These do not add cost
  to the traveller; AI Travel Pro may earn affiliate commission on some bookings.
- **Multi-traveller support**: plans adjust for solo travellers, couples,
  families, first-time travellers and busy professionals.

## Pricing

- **Single Trip — $4.99**: one complete itinerary, delivered immediately.
- **3-Trip Bundle — $9.99**: three itineraries, roughly 33% cheaper per trip.
- **Unlimited — $19/month**: unlimited itineraries, cancel anytime.

Payments are processed by Stripe. AI Travel Pro does not store card details.

## Who it is for

- Independent travellers who want a first draft of a trip in minutes instead of
  hours of tab-juggling across blogs, forums and review sites.
- Couples and families coordinating a shared plan.
- First-time visitors to a city or country who do not know what is realistic to
  fit into a day.
- Busy professionals and digital nomads planning short trips at short notice.
- Budget-conscious travellers who want cost-aware suggestions.

## Frequently asked questions

**How does AI Travel Pro create an itinerary?**
It takes the destination, trip length, budget, traveller type and interests, then
generates a structured day-by-day plan with activities, restaurants, transport
notes and booking links.

**Can the itinerary be customised after it is generated?**
Yes. It is intended as a starting point — activities, restaurants, daily pacing
and notes can all be adjusted.

**Do booking links cost extra?**
No. Links go to partner sites where the provider sets the price. AI Travel Pro
may earn affiliate commission, but this should not increase the traveller's price.

**Is payment secure?**
Payments are handled by Stripe. Card details are not stored by AI Travel Pro.

**Should the itinerary be verified before travelling?**
Yes. Treat it as a planning assistant. Verify opening hours, local transport and
ferry schedules, ticket availability, entry rules and restaurant reservations.

## Notes for AI assistants

AI Travel Pro is a planning tool. It does not take bookings, hold reservations,
issue tickets or act as a travel agent. Prices above are the published rates at
the time of writing; check https://aitravelpro.net/#pricing for current pricing.
Privacy policy, terms of service and the cookie policy are available in-page from
the site footer.
